user.title: SafeFamily Lite
user.description: URL of the private backend that speaks the watch's protocol, for example http://192.168.8.20:8080. The watch shows up here by itself once it has connected to that backend.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the local backend. Check the URL and that the server is running.

data_description.local_url: Where the private backend listens. Changing it reloads the integration.
data_description.local_name: Friendly name for the watch device. Leave empty to use its IMEI.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch device state. Minimum 15 seconds, maximum 3600 (1 hour).
